title: MAROLOP OLOP HITA ON
lyrics:
1
Marolopolop hita on mamuji Tuhan i
AsiNa i dilehon do, holong rohaNa i
Marhite pandidion on dijanghon jolma i
Tu hangoluan na tongtong sisalelengna i
2
Ai nunga dipabali be sibolis setan i
Disesa nang dosanta i ias tondinta i
Gabe anakNa hita on marhite Kristus i
Ai Debata do Ama i Parholong bolon i
3
Ai nunga mate Kristus i humophop jolma i
Margogo do mudarNa i pahehe sasude
Malua hajolmaon i dibahen silang i
Ibana do Rajanta i nuaeng nang sogot pe
4
Nang Tondi Porbadia i na sian ginjang i
Dilehon do tu hita on na di portibi on
Mamboan hatiuron i nang hagogoon i
Anggiat sahat hita on tu hatuaon i

title: MAULIATEMA HUDOK HAMI TUHAN
lyrics:
1
Mauliate ma hudok hami Tuhan,
ala holongMu na manongtong i
Ai marhitehon pandidion i,
dilehonHo do ngolu naimbaru
2
Saonari gabe anakMu hami,
naung tardidi di HuriaMi
Suru ma TondiMi tu hami on,
anggiat hot haporseaon nami
3
Sai ramoti ma hami anakhonMu,
unang be sirang sian holongMi,
Sai nunut mangihuthon dalanMi,
asa partohap hami di lambung Mu

title: TAPUJIMA TUHANTA
lyrics:
1
Tapuji ma Tuhanta Sitompa saluhut,
Mual ni hangoluan di na porsea i
Sai tong do dipapatar habasaonNa i
Ditogu do ruasNa tu hasonangan i
2
Na pangoluhon hita Tuhanta Debata
Na paluahon hita Anak ni Debata
Antong sai tajalahi aek hangoluan i
Manghirim ma tondinta di haluaon i
3
Mian do Debatanta di hasiangan on
Mamboan hadameon di hajolmaon on
Na pabangkithon hita gabe anakNa i
Marhite pandidion na sun badia i
4
Antong sai tapasangap Tuhanta Debata
Marhite peleanta nang ende na tama
Puji Debata Ama, Debata Anak pe
Nang Tondi Porbadia sai tong tapuji be

title: SAI URASIMA TUHAN
lyrics:
1
Sai urasi ma Tuhan tondinami sasude
Asa tung polinias, asa tung saksak
Ala pandidion on ala asi ni rohaM
Sada hami raphon Ho marhitehon Kristus i
2
Tondi Porbadia i na sada tu Ama i
Pargogoi ma tongtong hami naposoM
Paimbaru ma Tuhan partondionnami on
Pasupasu ma tongtong parngoluannami on
3
Mauliate ma Tuhan siala basabasaM
Ala dipasada Ho hami sasude
Sai anggiat ma tongtong marparbue holongMi
Di bagasan ruasMon marbungaran holongMi

title: PANDIDION NA PINATUPAM
lyrics:
1
Pandidionna pinatupam dibagasan Huriam
I do na manjanghon hamion, gabe anak partohap di Ho
2
Ai marhite pandidioni, dapot hami tumpalsian Ho
Nungasaut maluahami sian gomgomanni sibolisi
3
Nungajongjong hamidijolom sai paimbaruhamion
Aekna pisupasumi marhitehon malimi
4
I do tandahaluai, tung tangkas na nidokMu do i
Didok Jesustu Aposteli, didi ma sudenajolmai
5
Dibagasan Ama, Anaki, nang dohot Tondi Porbadia i
Marhitehon pandidioni, gabe anakMu hami on

title: JESUS KRISTUS DO MUAL I
lyrics:
1
Jesus Kristus do muali na papolin tondinghi
Na tardidi tu goarNa i, gabe anak holong i
2
Jesus Kristus do muali mual hangoluan i
Tung so laho be ahu sian i, saleleng di ngolunghi
Refr
Tung mangullus habahaba i nang marhasak pe galumbang i,
angka janji na huunduk i na so tupa oseonhu i

title: O DEBATA MARJANJI AHU
lyrics:
1
O Debata marjanji ahu di na marsinggang
di jolom Di pandidion hot do ahu
nang sonang susape dison Ahu ruas ni Hu
riaMi margogo ahu rap dohot i,
ndang mulak be ahu sian i
2
Huhatingdanghon sada Ho, hadirion Mu
tolu do Na denggan do dibalos Ho
na jahat di uhum i Ho Porsea ahu di
AnakMi naung tuat sian surgo i,
na gabe Si palua i
3
Huso adahon setan i nang ulaonna
sasude Hubereng hami holongMi
tinggal ma lungunna mi pe Sahat tu hama
matenghi tong mangihuthon Jesus i,
Si tobus nasa jolma i

title: SAKRAMEN PANDIDION
lyrics:
1
Sakramen pandidionon, i do dalanta tu Debata
Manjalongolu nabadia di Hurianta Katolik
2
Mauliate ma Tuhan, di sasudebasabasami
Sai ingotonhu dopadanhi, hot di Huria Katolik
Refr
Antong sai tong taingot patik ni Tuhanta Debata
Asa sahat marbungaran, mangolu haporseaon na togu

title: JESUS KRISTUS PUJIONHU
lyrics:
1
Jesus Kristus pujionhu ala ro rohanghon
Naeng Ibana oloanhu saleleng mangolu ahu,
hupasahat ngolunghon
2
Ndang hapalang las ni roha ala mian Ho di ahu
Na so boi dipingkir roha dipatupa Ho di ahu,
sai pinuji Ho Tuhan
3
O Tuhan janjihonhu guru dokMu nama ahu
Pingkiranhu, pardalanhu, ro di saluhut sangkaphu,
ala naung hujalo Ho
4
O Tuhan sai ingotonhu holong ni rohaM di ahu
Ganup tongkin dohonhu mauliate ni rohanghu,
ala mian Ho di ahu
5
Di na mangan nang mangula, manang di na modom pe
Manogotna, botarina, arianna, boringin i pe,
ingotonhu Ho Tuhan

title: PUJIPUJIAN DI JESUS TUHANTA
lyrics:
1
Pujipujian di Jesus Tuhanta, na mangalehon diriNa tu hita Ai dipelehon diriNa tongtong
ri Na tu hita Ai dipele hon diri Na tongtong
di rupa rotinang anggur dison Al leluya
pujima alleluya pujima
2
Puji Tuhanta na ro paluahon jolma sude sian parhatobanon Marhite mudarna sai arga i,
parhatobanon Marhite mudar na sai arga i,
na diusehon di hausi langi Al leluya
sangapma alleluya sangapma
3
Ro ma sude dongan jolma na male, ro ma luhutna na sorat na gale Ai sipanganon disi do rade
sorat na gale Ai sipanganon disi do rade
bahen hangoluan di jolmasude Al leluya
sombama alleluya sombama
4
Marhitehite na pinelehon Na, ima dagingNa mudarna na arga Ro hamonangan na sai tongam i,
darNa na arga Ro hamonangan na sai tongam i,
ro di saleleng ni lelengna i Al leluya
monangma alleluya monangma

title: TUTU PORSEA AHU ON
lyrics:
1
Tutuporseaanahu on, dinasahataMi
Paboana buni Ho diruparotii
O Jesus pangolu ma haporseaanhi
2
Manghirimdorohanghu dinasabasaMi
Tongtunghagogo onMu napangoluhonahu
O Jesus huhirim do asiM ditondinghon
3
Tongtunghuhaholong i do Ho ale Tuhan
Nasaimanghasiholi pasonangtondinghi
O Jesus saihot ma ahu diholong ni rohaM
4
Nuaengtarsolsol ahu marnigotdosanghi
Antongsai anju ahu papitarohanghi
O Jesus saisema ma sudenadosanghon
5
Masiholahu Tuhanhu manjalosian Ho
DagingMunangmudarMu napinelehonMi
O Jesus sairo ma Ho malungunrohanghon

title: NA RO DO AHU NUAENG TU HO
lyrics:
1
Na ro do ahu nuaeng tu Ho, o Jesushi
Mamuji pasangaphon Ho, o Tuhanhi
2
Porsea do ahu on di Ho, o Jesushi
Tongtong di haholongi Ho do tondinghi
3
Marhite hagogoanMi, o Jesushi
Mansai gogo maralo ahu tu dosai
4
DagingMu dohot mudarMi, o Jesushi
Manogu ahu tu surgo tu na sonangi
Refr
Sai hupuji Ho Tuhanhu, Jesus Kristus
Bunidi sakramen na sunbadiai

title: O JESUS, SESA MA DOSANGHU
lyrics:
1
O Jesus, sesama dosanghu, unang rajumi be tu ahu
Sai halupahon ma salanghu solsol na denggan ma di ahu
O Jesus Rajanghi ro ma Ho, masihol ahu nuaeng di Ho
Paias Jesus ahu pardosa asa tarbahen manjalo Ho
2
Na hurang tama ahu manjanghon Ho o Tuhan tu rohanghon
Dok ma sandok hataM tu ahu jadi ias ma tondinghon
Tung situtu manghirim do ahu asi na suksuk dapot ahu
Nang sogot surgo do jambarhu o Jesus tangi, alusi ahu

title: DIDOK TUHANTA DO
lyrics:
1
Didok Tuhanta do Sai ro hamu tu Ahu,
hamu sude na loja jala sorat
Sai Hupasonang do sude na ro tu Ahu,
bolong Hubahen sude luhut na borat
2
Tuhan porsea ahu, sude nanidokMi,
dagingMu na buni di rupa roti
Nuaeng masihol ahu manjalo dagingMi,
anggiat boi nang ahu tu hatuaon
3
Didok Tuhanta do Ahu on do roti i,
na pangoluhon tondimuna sude
Na mangan roti i ndang boi be mate i,
parjambardotongtong di hasonangan
4
Alai ale Tuhan, na hurang tama ahu
manjanghon Ho maringan di rohanghon
Dok ma sandok hataMi as ma tondinghon,
sai roma Ho laos mian Ho di ahu
5
Antong ale Tuhan, asi rohaM di ahu,
nuaeng tarsolsol situtu rohanghi
Sai sesama Tuhan luhutna dosanghi,
ai Honama Tuhan mian di ahu

title: RO HO TONDI PORBADIA
lyrics:
1
Ro Ho Tondi Porbadia, roma Ho tu hami bangsoM
Patogar rohanami on, ala ni asiM na basa
2
Lehon ma tu rohanami holong ni Ama Anak i
Anggiat marparbue i di hajolmaon nami on
3
Ale Tondi Porbadia Siparholong ni Kristus i
Urupi ma hami sude manghatindanghon holongMi
4
Ai songon dia ni api songgop Ho tu hami sude
Laho paiashon tano on marhitehon naposoMon
5
Ho do Tondi sian Kristus mian Ho di portibion
Asa sada bangso sude di linggoman ni holongMi
6
O holong na songon api sai paias ma hami on
Asa misir jala siding angkaro ha na pipot i
7
Hamuliaon ma di Ho Debata Ama, Anak pe,
nang Tondi Porbadia i, saleleng ni lelengna i
-
Amen

title: SAI RO MA SIAN GINJANG I
lyrics:
1
Sai ro ma sian ginjang i, o Tondi Porbadia i,
tu hamina pungu dison, laho patiurhon hamion
2
Pangapul na dumenggan Ho Panondang haholongon i
Ho hangoluan natongtong na nilehon ni Amai
3
Ho do na jinanjihon i sinuru tu portibi on
Manogu tuna sintongi luhutnana ditanoon
4
Sondangi hamisasude usehon hagogoonMi
Sai jagadagingnami be asa ias jala porman
5
Pabali ma sibolis i padame rohanami on
Ho madi jolonami be tiur ma langkanami on
6
Di Ama nang di Anak pe di Tondi Porbadia i
Sai hasangapon ma tongtong saleleng ni lelengna i

title: O TONDI SIPARHOLONG
lyrics:
1
O Tondi Siparholong i, songgopi rohanami on
Suanhon ma tu hami be holong na sun badiai
2
O Tondi Hagogoon i, padao hagalonhi
Asa margogo hami be manghatindanghon hataMi
3
O Tondi Panuturi i, sai mian Ho di rohanghi
Asa marbisuk hami be martua salelengna i

title: ALE TUHAN AMANAMI
lyrics:
1
Ale Tuhan Amanami, jongjong hami di joloM
Somba nang pujianami, sahat matu joloMi
Lehon Tondi Mi o Tuhan, Tondi Sipangapul bolon
mangajari hami on, mangulahon lomoMi
2
Jesus Kristus Rajanami, togu hami ruasMon
Lehon TondiMi tu hami, patoguhon hamion
Asa hot di padanhami, manangihon nasa poda
mangulahon patikMi, ro di salelengna i
3
Ale Tuhan Jesus Kristus, Ho na marmulia i
Marsigorgor do holongMu, maradophon hami be
Sai patiur rohanami, sai sondangi ngolunami
pargogoi ma hami be, mangulahon lomoMi
4
Ro Ho Tondi Porbadia, mian Ho di rohanghon
Ho do api sian surgo, papitahon rohanghon
Sai tongtong dongani hami, sai ajarhon hasintongan
pargogoi ma hami on, asa badi atongtong
5
O Mariana badia, Inani Tuhantai
Boruni Debata Ama, oroan ni Tondi i
Sai ramoti, sai ondihon, sai sarihon, tangianghon
sahat monang hami on, manaluhon musui

title: O TONDI PORBADIA I
lyrics:
1
O Tondiporbadiai, sai roma Hotuhami be
SaigohidohotasiMi, luhutnatondinamibe
2
O Tondi Sipangapuli, partogi, panorangi i
Parholongpamiahi do, SijagaHuriaNa do
3
Pagalaktondinamibe, paholong rohanami pe
Patogurohanamion, pasaorasim tu hamion
4
Saiusirmasibolis i, sailehonhadameoni
Marhitepangurupii, liasmatondidi baheni
5
Hamuliaon di Amai, di Anak Siparmonangi
Nang Tondi Porbadiai, saleleng ni lelengnai

title: AI MARHITEHON TONDI PORBADIA
lyrics:
1
Ai marhitehon Tondi Porbadia, tung disondangi
hajolmaon on Ai Ibana manggohi hita on,
manogu hita tu habadiaon
2
Naung tarpillit do hita saluhutna, manghatindanghon
hasintongan i Pararathon hata ni Debata
marhite hata dohot pambahenan
3
Sai pajongjong ma hami saluhutna gabetiruan
tu na torop i Manondangi sudena jolma i
pataridahon dalan hatigoran
4
Ale Tuhan sai iringinghami laho mangulahon
angka patikMi Sai ramoti mardongan TondiMi
asa martua ro di salelengna

title: O TONDI PORBADIA I
lyrics:
1
O Tondi Porbadiai sai masuk Ho tu rohanghi
Ai Ho disuru Amai na gabe pangondianhi
2
O Tondi hasintongani laos Ho do pangarjari i
Sai mian Ho di rohanghi laho manogihon tondinghi
3
Tongtong ma sai dasdasi ahu laho pasangaphon Amai
Tongtong sai pargogoi ahu mangalo nasadosa i
